rationale: Full documents for 512 candidate calls; 1 GiB result/64 MiB log candidate leaves diagnostic/receipt space relative to artificial shapes. This is a proposed STOP cap, never a bound or guarantee for real rational or angle Evidence sizes. No compression ratio or artificial per-trial size is assumed for live data.
static_growth: Exact integer/rational numerator/denominator and angle certificates can grow with actual packet/law computations. Current artificial schema does not bound their live bit lengths; budget exceed must STOP without dropping diagnostics or increasing sampling.
